verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: After dash-down collects one coin, state.coins is 1 but the HUD reads 'Coins 0/5'.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current coin count, so after collecting one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Spike damage corrupts score: jumps to 65136 and goes negative
verdicts.observed: Score went 100 -> 65136 on a dash that hit spikes (lives 3->2), then to -300 and -200 later. Score is negative, and a spike hit raised it.
verdicts.expected: Spikes subtract 500 points floored at 0, so score should go 100 -> 0. Score must stay within 0..999999 and coins must only add points.

verdicts.title: Paused-frozen check flags restart (false positive)
verdicts.observed: The player position and timer changed while paused, but only because btn-restart reset the level. The check does not exempt restart events.
verdicts.expected: Restart is an explicit exception to the frozen-while-paused rule. The real defect (game stays paused after restart) is captured by candidate 3, not here.

verdicts.title: Restart level leaves the game paused instead of running
verdicts.observed: After pause then click btn-restart, the level resets (score 0, lives 3) but mode stays 'paused' and the pause menu remains open. Nothing progresses over 30 further ticks.
verdicts.expected: Restart puts the level back to its starting state and the game is running again straight away (mode 'playing', no pause menu).

verdicts.title: Two dash keys in one tick move the player 3 tiles
verdicts.observed: dash-right+dash-right in one tick moved the player from (1,1) to (4,1): a 2-tile dash plus a step, with events dash, move, coin.
verdicts.expected: At most one move (a step or a dash) per tick. Of the movement keys pressed in a tick only the last counts, so the player should move 2 tiles at most.

verdicts.title: Movement key pressed after pause in the same tick still moves the player
verdicts.observed: pause+up: the game paused, but the player still moved from (1,2) to (1,1) with a move event and timer change in that tick.
verdicts.expected: Pause takes effect immediately. The rest of that tick's input is ignored and nothing moves that tick.

verdicts.title: Hit on a respawn-eligible tick is legal (false positive)
verdicts.observed: At tick 5 the player (inv=0 before the tick) steps down onto enemy e1 at (1,5), takes a hit, and respawns at (1,1) with inv=4. The check flags the 'respawn' event itself, but a hit always causes a respawn.
verdicts.expected: A hit with invulnerable=0 costs a life and respawns the player at (1,1). This matches section 5. The check's condition is wrong because it treats the respawn caused by the hit as a violation.

verdicts.title: Toast covers the pause menu's Resume button
verdicts.observed: At tick 24, after the player collects a key-toast ('Key collected - find the locked door') and the game is paused, the pause dialog's btn-resume reports top=false. Something else (the toast) sits on top of it, so a click on Resume would not reach it.
verdicts.expected: Every visible button must be clickable. Nothing may cover the Resume button while the pause menu is open (section 7).

verdicts.title: HUD coin counter stays at 0/5 after collecting a coin
verdicts.observed: At tick 0 the player collects a coin (state coins=1, score=100), but the HUD still shows 'Coins 0/5'.
verdicts.expected: The HUD always shows the current values (section 8), so after collecting one coin it should read 'Coins 1/5'.

verdicts.title: Spikes at score 0 wrap the score to 65036, which then goes negative
verdicts.observed: At tick 7 the player at score 0 hits spikes. The score becomes 65036 instead of staying at 0. Later a coin (+100) plus a spike-free step lead to score -400 at tick 9, so the score is negative.
verdicts.expected: Spikes cost 500 points but the score stops at 0 and never goes below it. The score must stay within 0..999,999, so it should read 0 after the spikes and never be negative.
